en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a detailed interior scene beneath a richly ornamented Gothic arch. The image depicts numerous men in period clothing gathered in discussion, some seated and some standing, with portraits and stained-glass windows in the background. Beneath the image is a printed German caption identifying the scene as a consultation about the Leipzig Interim in the presence of Elector Moritz in 1548 at the royal Albrechtsburg in Meissen.
